items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: the piano players of that period like Bud Powell, Al Haig -- and Dorothy Donzgan was around there... Erroll Garner used to say -- Garner came up in the bebop movement with Charlie Parker and Dizzy and all those guys dominated, on 52nd Street, and the piano players of that period like Bud Powell

ctx.x: Yeah, he played with Trent's band. Trent played the piano and Stuff stood in front of the band with a violin. That was based in Dallas. That's a lot of jazz town. You know, the Johnson Brothers came out of Dallas, Keg and Bud.
